spellbook.finance/limitations: price is the daily catalogue price of the regular printing, and each change field compares it with an earlier daily snapshot. None of it is a sale, a quote, or what a marketplace will pay today. Confirm a price on the marketplace before acting on it.
Band fields use the regular printing's price only, over the last 20 daily closes with missing days dropped. They are null when a printing has fewer than 20 closes.
bbPos and z20 are null when the last 20 closes never moved, because a flat price has no band. Any band or z-score bound drops those rows. Use flat_days_min to find them.

squeeze compares the Bollinger band with a Keltner channel built from close-to-close change, because no daily high or low exists. A charting package that uses highs and lows reports a different squeeze.
A low bbPos or z20 says where today's price sits against its own last 20 days. It does not predict a rise. This tool labels no card oversold or undervalued, so decide what the numbers mean yourself.
change90d is null when the printing had no price 90 days before the snapshot.
The snapshot rebuilds once a day. Read updatedAt before calling a row current.
Magic printings only. Call spellbook_movers for the biggest moves in other games.

description: Screen Magic card printings by price, price change and 20 day band statistics in one call. Each row carries the printing identity (scryfallId, name, setCode, rarity), price, and change7d, change30d and change90d in percent. Its band fields: ma20 is the mean of the last 20 daily closes. bbPos is where today's close sits inside the 20 day Bollinger band, 0 at the lower band and 100 at the upper, and below 0 or above 100 outside it. bbWidth is the band's width as a percent of ma20. z20 is today's close minus ma20, in 20 day standard deviations. squeeze and squeezeRecent say whether the Bollinger band sat inside the Keltner channel today, or on any of the last 5 days. flatDays counts the days since the price last changed. Call it to answer "which cards sit near the bottom of their recent range", "which cards fell this month inside a 90 day rise" or "which prices have gone quiet", then call spellbook_card_prices for one printing's per-source prices. Rows come back in the sort the caller names. Nothing is scored, labeled or chosen for you.

band_pos_max.description: Highest bbPos a row may have. 100 is the upper band. Pass a low value such as 10 to keep cards near the bottom of their range. Omit for no ceiling.

band_pos_min.description: Lowest bbPos a row may have. 0 is the lower band. Once any band or z-score bound is set, rows with a null bbPos are dropped. Omit for no floor.

band_width_max.description: Widest bbWidth a row may have, in percent of ma20. A small value keeps cards whose price barely moved. Omit for no ceiling.

change30d_max.description: Highest 30 day change a row may have, in percent. Pass a negative number to keep cards that fell. Rows with no 30 day change are dropped. Omit for no ceiling.

change90d_min.description: Lowest 90 day change a row may have, in percent. Pair a positive value with change30d_max to keep cards that fell this month inside a 90 day rise. Rows with no 90 day change are dropped. Omit for no floor.

flat_days_min.description: Fewest days since the price last changed. Use it for flat prices, which carry no band position. Omit for no floor.

max_price.description: Highest current price in USD. Omit for no ceiling.

min_price.description: Lowest current price in USD. Omit for the default, which is 1, or 5 once any band or z-score bound is set, because cheap printings sit flat for weeks.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Read totalPages on the response before paging. Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Rows per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 25.

period.description: Which change window the changePct sort reads. Defaults to 90d. Band fields always use the last 20 daily closes.

sort.description: Which field orders the rows. changePct reads the change over `period`, and rows with no change come last. Defaults to changePct.

sort_dir.description: Sort direction for `sort`. Defaults to desc, largest first. Pass asc with changePct to list the biggest falls first.

squeeze_recent.description: Pass true to keep only rows whose Bollinger band sat inside the Keltner channel on any of the last 5 days. Omit to keep every row.

zscore_max.description: Highest z20 a row may have. A negative value such as -1.5 keeps cards priced below their 20 day mean. Omit for no ceiling.

zscore_min.description: Lowest z20 a row may have. Omit for no floor.

name: spellbook_screener
